newsitem.title: USA: American Soybean Association opens India office.
newsitem.headline: American Soybean Association opens India office.

text.p: The American Soybean Association said it opened an Asian Subcontinent Marketing Office in New Delhi with the aim of increasing soybean and soyproduct usage in India and Pakistan.
India is a major competitor for the U.S. soybean industry in Asian markets, exporting nearly 90 percent of its domestic soymeal production, the ASA said.
"One goal is to help them consume more of their own soybeans," ASA communications director Bob Callanan said.
The office will be headed by Virgil Miedema, a former official of the Agency for International Development.
ASA is a farmer-funded market promotion group with 29,000 members in the United States and offices in 13 countries.
